items.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah to address Gopalak Sammelan in Bhopal and inaugurate State-Level Exhibition on Nyaya Sanhita
items.summary: In line with Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s vision of ‘Sahkar se Samriddhi’ and under the leadership of Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah, several significant initiatives are being undertaken to make the country’s cooperative sector stronger, modern and self-reliant.
key_facts: During the programme, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) will be exchanged between KRIBHCO and the Madhya Pradesh State Biodiversity Board for developing an urban forest in Bhopal under the ‘Morvan Project’.
On the occasion, Shri Amit Shah will digitally lay the foundation stone for a Milk Processing Plant with a capacity of 3 lakh litres per day in Ujjain, to be established at a cost of ₹255 crore.
He will also inaugurate a Product Dairy Plant in Bhopal, built at a cost of ₹16.5 crore, with a capacity of 40,000 litres per day.

items.title: DRI cracks down on illegal wildlife trafficking; elephant ivory, leopard skin, live pangolins and tiger parts seized; 11 persons arrested
items.summary: Continuing its efforts to combat illegal wildlife trafficking and the illicit trade in protected wildlife products, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has, in three intelligence-led operations, seized four elephant ivory articles including intricately carved ivory articles, one leopard skin, two live…
key_facts: Eleven persons have been apprehended in the three operations.
The operation resulted in the recovery of the four wildlife articles and apprehension of three persons involved in the transaction.
Possession without licence and trade/dealing in elephant ivory and articles made therefrom are prohibited under Section 49B of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.

items.title: DRI busts two-way gold-diamond smuggling syndicate at Mumbai airport
items.summary: Continuing its sustained crackdown on organised smuggling, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has busted a sophisticated two-way smuggling syndicate operating through Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai, resulting in the seizure of 8.564 kg of 24-carat foreign-origin gold valued at…
key_facts: Eight persons, including an airport staff member, six transit passengers and an Indian outbound passenger, have been arrested.
During his personal search, the airport staff was also found carrying three capsules containing foreign-origin gold dust in wax form, which had been handed over to him by a transit passenger.
The airport staff further revealed that five more transit passengers arriving on different flights from Dubai, Doha, Jeddah and Fujairah were also scheduled to deliver smuggled gold to him.

items.title: Mumbai's Jawahar Dweep Becomes India's First Plastic-free Oil Terminal
items.summary: Mumbai Port Authority declared its Jawahar Dweep Marine Oil Terminal plastic-free, a milestone in the port's push toward more sustainable operations. The declaration came during Swachhata Abhiyan 2026, a cleanliness program held at Grey Gate, Indira Dock, Mumbai to mark the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.

items.title: Sikkim Delegation Explores Rajasthan’s Rich Heritage under Yuva Sangam Phase VII
items.summary: The Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, is organising Yuva Sangam Phase VII under the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat programme to strengthen people-to-people connections and promote mutual understanding among the youth of India.
key_facts: The first tour of Yuva Sangam Phase VII was flagged off from Sikkim University, the nodal institution, on 25 September 2026, marking the commencement of the Sikkim–Rajasthan exchange.
The Sikkim delegation arrived in Jodhpur on 29 September 2026 and is participating in a series of cultural and educational engagements to experience Rajasthan’s heritage, traditions and history.
As part of the visit, the delegation visited Mehrangarh Fort on 1 October 2026.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh–Karnataka Delegation of Yuva Sangam Phase VII Embarks on a Journey of Cultural Discovery and Youth Exchange
items.summary: The Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education, is organising Yuva Sangam Phase VII under the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat programme to strengthen people-to-people connections and promote national integration among the youth.
key_facts: The Madhya Pradesh–Karnataka delegation, with School of Planning and Architecture (SPA), Bhopal as the nodal institute, was flagged off on 26 September 2026.
The delegation is visiting Karnataka, hosted by the Central University of Karnataka, to experience the State’s rich heritage, traditions, cuisine, landscapes and cultural diversity.
A key highlight of the visit was the interaction of the Madhya Pradesh delegation with Governor of Karnataka Shri Thawar Chand Gehlot on 1 October 2026.

items.title: 2.42 Lakh Special Gram Sabhas Across India Put Citizen-Centric Initiatives at the Heart of Grassroots Discussions on Gandhi Jayanti
items.summary: On the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, Special Gram Sabhas were held across the country, with more than 2.42 lakh Special Gram Sabhas scheduled on the GPDP Portal (https://gpdp.nic.in) and Panchayat NIRNAY Portal (https://meetingonline.gov.in).
key_facts: Agenda and awareness material highlighting key government initiatives, including transformative governance reforms and citizen-centric measures undertaken over the last twelve years, were read out and deliberated upon.

The nationwide conduct of these Special Gram Sabhas was supported by the coordinated efforts of partner Ministries and Departments, along with their field and grassroots-level functionaries and MY Bharat volunteers.
The Ministry has been rolling out the People’s Plan Campaign in all States and Union Territories since 2018 to enable Panchayats to prepare evidence-based, holistic and participatory plans.
